stem:
Meera looks at the Moon from her balcony in Jaipur at 9 p.m. on Monday. She looks again at 9 p.m. on Tuesday.

What will she most likely observe?

options.text: The Moon will be in exactly the same position in the sky.
The Moon will appear in a different part of the sky.
The Moon will not be visible at all on Tuesday.
The Moon will rise at exactly the same time as the Sun sets.

teacher.key_rationale: As the Moon advances in its orbit while Earth rotates, it returns to nearly the same sky position about 50 minutes later each day, so at the same clock time on successive days it appears in a different part of the sky; it does not follow the Sun's daily schedule or rise at sunset each day.
